title: Bill Clinton's 'tar baby' remark to Rockefeller at the ranch

tellings.quote: He told Rockefeller it's like the story of the uh tar baby.

plain: In 1995, at the Wyoming ranch of the wealthy philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller, President Bill Clinton is said to have told Rockefeller that the UFO question was "like the story of the tar baby," the old folk tale of a figure that sticks to whoever touches it. A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, it would mean a sitting president saw the subject as something he dared not get stuck to.
